title: Ashgrove CareAssure Inflation Protection Options and Rates
content:
**Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance — inflation protection options offered at issue**

Each Ashgrove CareAssure tier offers three inflation protection choices at issue: no inflation protection, a 3 percent compound option and a 5 percent compound option. The rate is the annual compound increase applied under the option. The 5 percent compound option is offered only up to a highest issue age set per tier.

| Tier | Options offered | Annual compound increase, 3 percent option | Annual compound increase, 5 percent option | Highest issue age for the 5 percent option |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | None; 3 percent compound; 5 percent compound | 0.03 | 0.05 | 65 |

### Age boundary for the 5 percent option

| Tier | Issue age 65 | Issue age 66 | Issue age 70 | Issue age 71 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2-Year, 3-Year, 4-Year, 5-Year, 6-Year | Offered | Offered | Offered | Not offered |
| Lifetime | Offered | Not offered | Not offered | Not offered |

Issue age 71 is in any case above the highest issue age of the Lifetime tier (70).

### Rates in percent

The annual compound increase is 0.03, that is 3 percent, under the 3 percent compound option, and 0.05, that is 5 percent, under the 5 percent compound option, in every tier.
